description: 北九州市 ごみ焼却工場維持管理状況 [waste management] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. ごみ焼却工場（新門司工場、日明工場、皇后崎工場）の維持管理状況（焼却量、燃焼ガス温度、集じん器流入温度、排ガス中CO濃度）です。. Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are 集計. It offers 137 resource(s) in xls, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
